strings.subtitle: PROC 0x00 // CLASS: ABSENCE
strings.briefing:
Station telemetry came back with holes in it. 23 readings in temp_c never wrote — the sensor dropped frames, and pandas is showing you NaN where a number should be.

The Sentinel is not a monster standing next to your data. It is the absence inside it. Fill every gap in temp_c and it has nowhere left to live.
